purpose: Engineering readout of graph-local information in frozen LFM2.5-230M representations

source.row_input: input_text only enters the backbone; bindings and goal are span coordinates only
source.truth: canonical worlds are joined only after extraction

splits.development: canonical DEV worlds only; fixed training schedule, diagnostic scores
splits.test: canonical test worlds; no model/epoch selection
splits.renderer_robustness: report by S0-S11 and same-world paired renderer rows; S7/S8/S9 are renderer-held-out families

local_pooling.all_entity_mentions: prefer exact binding mention matches in the pre-Goal context; when absent, align the rendered entity ID token as a symbolic argument reference; mean token pool per occurrence, then mean over occurrences for that entity
local_pooling.goal_arguments: exact binding mention matches restricted to the final Goal: field, with exact entity-ID reference fallback; each goal argument gets its own vector
local_pooling.middle_plus_final: concatenate midpoint-layer mention-span mean and final-layer mention-span mean
local_pooling.final_plus_mean: concatenate final-layer last-subtoken-of-mention and final-layer mention-span mean
local_pooling.layer_m4_final: layer four transformer blocks before final, mention-span mean
local_pooling.missing_span: zero vector with matched=false; omitted from task examples

tasks.node_type: predict canonical type of each entity from its masked-in-text mention vector; report goal-argument subset separately
tasks.edge_existence: predict whether an ordered pair has any binary initial_state fact
tasks.edge_label: predict one binary fact predicate, with NONE negatives
tasks.one_hop_membership: predict undirected CONNECTED shortest-path distance exactly one
tasks.two_hop_membership: predict undirected CONNECTED shortest-path distance exactly two; direct edges excluded from negative candidates
tasks.link_completion: for each binary (subject,predicate,object) fact, rank all other entities in the same world as candidate objects using the predicate score

readouts.linear: affine classifier over one node vector or ordered concatenated endpoint vectors
readouts.bilinear: quadratic node readout or rank-128 factorized endpoint bilinear readout
readouts.tiny_mlp: one 128-unit GELU hidden layer with dropout 0.1

controls: mention-string lexical type heuristic and type-pair-conditioned frequency baseline
cached Rung-0 whole-row surfaces with linear readout

engineering_gate.pass: at least one graph-local task exceeds its strongest applicable lexical/frequency control by >=0.05 absolute on its primary metric, retains a positive advantage on held-out renderer families S7/S8/S9, and loses no more than 0.10 absolute versus in-family test
engineering_gate.otherwise: stop the graph-local lane at Rung 1; do not search additional surfaces

limits: No GNN claim, natural-language graph claim, authority change, retrieval, or serving promotion
Whole-row caches are reused read-only from the locked Rung-0 atlas
